verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms Slack has a CLI/Bolt SDK and Web API for building and modifying app behavior, plus workflow branching that presents users with different interactive options, which gestures toward interactive app UI. However, none of the evidence explicitly documents Block Kit, modals, buttons, or structured message layouts — the specific building blocks the story asks about. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of modals, buttons/interactive components, and Block Kit message layout building, plus any hands-on/independent confirmation of these UI primitives.
